2. In C.P. 350 of 1983, the petitioner/ father challenged the grant of
maintenance to his minor son who is infirm and disabled. His Constitutional
Petition having been dismissed by the High Court, leave to appeal has now been
sought.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner admits that the amount of
maintenanceâ€‘â€‘ Rs.100 per mensem for such a boy is not at all
excessive; but he has contended that the petitioner did not have enough

4. The learned Single Judge in the High Court having noticed the plea
raised in this Court, has repelled it with cogent reasons. No justification
having been found for interference by this Court, leave to appeal is refused
